title: Climate action revolving fund from hotel tax
summary: On June 16, the committee held a roll call vote to file the climate fund proposal, and the budget director estimated the fund would be about $13 million in fiscal year 27. Bill 66 (2026) would create a Climate Action and Resiliency Revolving Fund starting at 20 percent of TAT revenue. The budget director said a fund set by ordinance would raise fewer rating agency concerns than one in the County charter.
